description:
Based on the CG collections by Rokumarusou (ろくまる荘).

There was a notorious group of pickup artists around campus, everywhere they went, they tried to hook up with women. Then one day, after an incident with a gang of thugs, all the members of this obnoxious group died.
However, when they woke up they were in another world! And there's no reason they can't pick up girls there, too...

(Source: DLsite English)

Notes:
- Download version was delivered in advance on April 28, 2022.
